data.methodNote: Region set and state groupings are taken verbatim from the ACL 'Seasonal Produce List by Region' chart (s6); Northwest, Alaska, and Hawaii are omitted to keep six contiguous CONUS regions. ACL lists produce by season; months are mapped by the meteorological convention (spring Mar-May, summer Jun-Aug, fall Sep-Nov, winter Dec-Feb) - stated method, not a source claim. Source qualifiers: '(early)' items appear only in the season's first month, '(late)' items only in its last month. Region-season lists are transcribed verbatim from the chart's text extraction and cross-checked against the FDPIR national month chart (s7). Source group names map to single identities: 'Melons' -> cantaloupe, 'Lettuces & greens' -> lettuce, 'Chicories' -> chicory greens, 'String beans' -> green beans, 'Summer squash'/'Summer & Winter squash' -> zucchini (+ acorn winter squash), 'Mandarins'/'Tangerines' -> tangerines (mandarin oranges), 'Key limes' -> limes, 'Sunchokes' -> Jerusalem artichoke, 'Vidalia onions' -> onions, 'Pumpkins & gourds' -> pumpkin, 'Grapes & Muscadines' -> grapes. Chart items dropped (no citable plain raw USDA identity available this session): horseradish, figs, apricots, fiddleheads, garlic scapes, currants, gooseberries, boysenberries, lima beans, almonds, walnuts, pecans, dates, sorghum, paw paws. The USDA FDC API returned OVER_RATE_LIMIT for follow-up verification of horseradish and figs (api.nal.usda.gov, 2026-10-11); they are dropped and recorded as gaps, not estimated. The SNAP-Ed Seasonal Produce Guide (snaped.fns.usda.gov) could not be text-retrieved this session (JavaScript-rendered pages); it is documented in SOURCES.md as an unverified complementary source.
